Brief definition/safety clarifications are labeled and listed separately.

visualReview.purpose: Pelvis, head/fontanelle landmarks, vaginal assessment, lie/attitude/position, and station diagrams reviewed in full-page contact sheets.

Reviewed equipment diagrams, acceleration/pattern comparisons, actual early/late/variable/prolonged strips, variability examples, and image-only management slides. Pages 27 and 28 are the two practice-strip examples, not pages 46–49 (which are text management slides). No fabricated full-window measurements or category labels inferred from cropped illustrations.

clarifications.issue: Example labor durations and delayed pushing treated as universal instructions
clarifications.handling: Preserves stage/phase teaching but avoids automatic time limits or a routine 90-minute pushing delay.

clarifications.issue: External toco suggests quantitative pressure and internal monitoring promises no artifact
clarifications.handling: Clarifies external timing versus true IUPC pressure measurement and retains signal verification responsibility.

clarifications.issue: Acceleration duration <30 seconds; minimal variability <5; prolonged duration missing upper limit
clarifications.handling: Labels usual term acceleration ≥15 bpm for ≥15 seconds to <2 minutes, minimal detectable variability ≤5 bpm, and prolonged deceleration ≥2 to <10 minutes as definition clarifications.

clarifications.issue: Tachysystole is named in the objective but not numerically defined in the slides
clarifications.handling: Adds only the necessary definition, >5 contractions/10 minutes averaged over 30 minutes, with immediate response to acute compromise rather than waiting.

clarifications.issue: Minimal/absent variability alone said to indicate acidemia; Category III list omits combination
clarifications.handling: Explains that low variability alone does not prove acidemia and identifies absent variability plus recurrent late/variable decelerations or bradycardia, or a sinusoidal pattern.

clarifications.issue: Routine oxygen and internal monitors presented as general correction for FHR abnormalities
clarifications.handling: Labels oxygen guidance for maternal hypoxia/clinical indication; internal monitors improve measurement rather than correcting oxygenation by themselves.

clarifications.issue: Epidural anatomy, >5-cm delay, and fixed 2-liter preload
clarifications.handling: Separates epidural/intrathecal spaces, qualifies arbitrary dilation and fluid rules, and defers individual contraindications/administration to anesthesia.

clarifications.issue: Newborn naloxone dose table could displace neonatal resuscitation
clarifications.handling: Does not reproduce the dose table; emphasizes ventilation/resuscitation first for ineffective breathing.

clarifications.issue: All prior cesareans treated as induction contraindication; vasa previa equated with off-center insertion
clarifications.handling: Qualifies scar/method-specific eligibility and defines the relevant fetal-vessel location. Does not introduce additional induction methods.

clarifications.issue: Universal Cervidil repeat doses and oxytocin loading-dose wording
clarifications.handling: Defers dosing/removal/spacing to actual product orders; identifies oxytocin as a titrated infusion rather than an IV push. No replacement dose table is added.

materialLimits.handling: The PDFs do not give a complete amniotomy protocol. The notes define it and connect it with supplied membrane/engagement/cord-risk and monitoring material; the gap is explicitly identified.

sharedViews: All eight answers are reused in the existing Week 8 review; four also appear on the existing fetal-monitoring exam-topic page. Routing, source PDFs/previews, infographic/presentation order, videos, practice and navigation are unchanged.
limits: Source-led educational summary. Checks verify coverage, source integrity, shared safe rendering and preservation; they are not independent clinical validation.
